name: Revolut Ltd
description:
At Revolut, we believe that there is always a more innovative way of doing things. That is why we are pioneering a new way of moving money around the globe; leading a global money movement solution to combat FX commission charges. Our app and multi-currency card enable you to send, spend and save money with the touch of a button on your mobile.

Revolut lets you convert your money in to 90 different currencies, as if you had a local bank card available in your back pocket, in every country you visited, all around the world! We aim to become the only fully comprehensive single card you will ever need, wherever, and whenever.

We also believe you should be closer to your family and friends - Revolut gives you the opportunity to move funds between users instantly or send bank transfers; all for free!

Revolut is one of the fastest growing Fintech companies globally, having attracted investment from leading Venture Capital firms such as Index Ventrues, Balderton Capital and Point 9. Revolut has engineered explosive growth since its launch in July 2015 with over 500,000 sign ups and has processed more than $2bn in transactions..

We have been featured as a leading FinTech company in Forbes, CNN, CNBC, The Guardian, The Times alongside many other globally recognised media publications..

Having won numerous awards and being selected by KPMG as a Global Fintech 100, in addition to receiving a$10m series A investment, Revolut is now ready to embark on the next stage of its expansion.

We are a diverse, multicultural team, and we are looking for like-minded individuals to join the Revolut family!
